new_packages.label: צַדִּיק וְחָכְמָה
new_packages.label_en: The Tzadik and Wisdom — Sun, Moon, and the Two Modes
new_packages.justification: This package is fully justified by the source text of Torah #16. There are 6 explicit bechina-language equations forming a tightly connected independent conceptual domain not covered by any existing dataset package for this Torah. The domain: the Tzadik and the two states of his wisdom-consciousness. The Rebbe equates: (1) כּוֹרָא = צַדִּיק ('הַמְכֻנֶּה בְּשֵׁם דָּג' — called by the name fish); (2) מַיִם = חָכְמוֹת עֶלְיוֹנוֹת ('הַיְנוּ כַּד מַפִּיק אֶת עַצְמוֹ מֵחָכְמוֹת עֶלְיוֹנוֹת'); (3) עֵינַיִם = חָכְמָה ('מְכֻנִּים עַל שֵׁם הַחָכְמָה'); (4) עֵינַיִם בְּעֵת עֵסֶק = שֶׁמֶשׁ ('עֵינָיו בִּבְחִינַת שֶׁמֶשׁ'); (5) עֵינַיִם בְּסִלּוּק = יָרֵחַ ('נִשְׁתָּאֲרִים עֵינָיו בִּבְחִינַת סִהֲרֵי'). All 5 sub-equations share a single essential nature: the Tzadik's consciousness as a two-state system — the solar state (full immersion in supernal wisdom) and the lunar state (temporary withdrawal into worldly engagement). Water, eyes, sun, moon are all expressions of the same underlying structure of the Tzadik's spiritual anatomy. The dominant node is צַדִּיק (the highest-degree concept, anchoring all other bechinas: the fish IS the Tzadik; the water IS his wisdom; the eyes ARE his wisdom; the sun IS his eyes-in-wisdom; the moon IS his eyes-in-withdrawal).

proposed_edges.proof: וַחֲזֵינָא הַאי כַּוְרָא, שֶׁהוּא הַצַּדִּיק, הַמְכֻנֶּה בְּשֵׁם דָּג, כַּיָּדוּעַ
דְּאַפִּיק רֵישָׁא מִמַּיָּא, הַיְנוּ כַּד מַפִּיק אֶת עַצְמוֹ מֵחָכְמוֹת עֶלְיוֹנוֹת
כִּי פְּקִיחַת עֵינַיִם מְכֻנִּים עַל שֵׁם הַחָכְמָה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב: וַתִּפָּקַחְנָה עֵינֵי שְׁנֵיהֶם
וּכְשֶׁעוֹסֵק בְּחָכְמָתוֹ, אֲזַי עֵינָיו בִּבְחִינַת שֶׁמֶשׁ
נִשְׁתָּאֲרִים עֵינָיו בִּבְחִינַת סִהֲרֵי, כִּי סִהֲרָא אֵין מְאִירָה אֶלָּא כַּד נִסְתַּלֵּק הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ

new_packages.cross_torah_notes: The core bechina מים = חכמה is a fundamental equation across many Torahs (cf. 'מַיִם שְׁאָבוּ רוּחַ הַקּוֹדֶשׁ'; Torah #1 connects wisdom to the flowing letter ח = חיות). The שמש/ירח duality for wisdom-states appears structurally in multiple teachings. Here in Torah #16 it is given its fullest and most concrete form through the Tzadik-as-fish allegory.

new_packages.label: גְּאֻלָּה וּמְשִׁיחִין
new_packages.label_en: Redemption and the Two Messiahs — The Eschatological Resolution
new_packages.justification: This package is justified by 3+ explicit bechina-language equations forming an independent eschatological domain. The Rebbe equates: (1) תְּרֵי אוּסְיָא = תְּרֵין מְשִׁיחִין ('הֵם בְּחִינַת תְּרֵין מְשִׁיחִין' — explicit בְּחִינַת); (2) תְּרֵי נְהָרוֹת דְּסוּרָא = תְּרֵין מְשִׁיחִין ('כִּנְהָרוֹת אֶצְלָם' — the rivers of Sura ARE the messianic channels); (3) שָׂפָה בְרוּרָה = אוֹר הַלְּבָנָה כְּאוֹר הַחַמָּה (the pure speech of the messianic era = the state where moon shines like sun — the eschatological resolution where the Tzadik no longer needs to withdraw). All three share the same essential nature: the redemptive force that transforms the nations' darkness into light, eliminates the forced oscillation of the Tzadik's wisdom-states, and unifies the solar and lunar modes. This domain is independent of the Tzadik/Wisdom package: it is not about the Tzadik's inner spiritual anatomy, but about the external Messianic agents that resolve the structural problem the evil package creates.

proposed_edges.proof: וְנָפִיץ מַיָּא מִתְּרֵי אוּסְיָא – הֵם בְּחִינַת תְּרֵין מְשִׁיחִין
עַל־יָדָם יִגָּאֲלוּ וְיִמָּשְׁכוּ כִּנְהָרוֹת אֶצְלָם לִלְמֹד דְּבַר ה'
וְיֵהָפֵךְ לְכֻלָּם שָׂפָה בְרוּרָה, אָז יִתְקַיֵּם: וְהָיָה אוֹר הַלְּבָנָה כְּאוֹר הַחַמָּה

new_packages.cross_torah_notes: תרין משיחין (Mashiach ben Yosef and Mashiach ben David) are an important node-pair in multiple Torahs. The image of מַעְיְנוֹת flowing outward ('יָפוּצוּ מַעְיְנוֹתֶיךָ חוּצָה' — Proverbs 5:16) is the classic Messianic image in Chassidut, used explicitly in the closing line of this Torah. The equation שפה ברורה = universal Torah-speech is a distinctive feature of this Torah and connects it to the broader theme of language/speech in the Tzadik's transmission role.

full_package_map_after_additions.description: If all additions in torah_16_additions.json are implemented, Torah #16 would have 3 packages:

packages.label: סוּרָא וְהָעַכּוּ"ם — Nations as Clouds of Concealment
צַדִּיק וְחָכְמָה — The Tzadik's Two Wisdom-States
גְּאֻלָּה וּמְשִׁיחִין — Redemption and the Two Messiahs

full_package_map_after_additions.teaching_argument: The nations (Package 1: evil) — covering the Tzadik's wisdom-eyes like clouds — FORCE the Tzadik (Package 2: good) to periodically withdraw from wisdom. The two Messiahs (Package 3: good) will spread Torah to all nations, converting the clouds into rivers, so that the moon shines like the sun and the Tzadik's wisdom never again needs to be interrupted.

observations: Torah #16 is a short but conceptually rich teaching with a clear 3-domain structure: (1) evil: the nations/concealment, (2) good: the Tzadik and his wisdom-oscillation, (3) good: the Messianic resolution. All three domains have 3+ nodes with explicit bechina-language equations in the source text. The current dataset captures only 1 of the 10 bechina relationships (10% coverage), making this the most under-represented Torah in the range analyzed. The two proposed new packages (NP1: Tzadik/Wisdom and NP2: Redemption/Messiahs) are the critical missing backbone. Both meet the threshold for new packages: 3+ concepts, explicit bechina language, independent conceptual domain not covered by existing dataset packages.
